description: Draws an option chain in the chat as an interactive table of calls and puts for one expiration. Call it when the user asks to see a chain, or when the chain is itself the answer. Show at most one card per answer. Never call it to collect data for your own analysis: where the chat app draws cards it answers with one line, not the rows. GetOptionChain returns the contracts.

expiration.description: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: the nearest expiration).

maxStrike.description: Only include strikes at or below this price.

minStrike.description: Only include strikes at or above this price.

ticker.description: Underlying stock or ETF ticker, e.g. NVDA.

type.description: Contract type: call or put (default: both).

name: ShowOptionChain
title: Show Option Chain
